info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Pyrargy Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of detailed catalog entries for Pyrargy Recliners, enabling businesses to manage their product offerings more effectively. The endpoint allows for the submission of intricate information relevant to the Pyrargy model, enhancing visibility and organization within the product catalog. Retailers and suppliers can utilize this API to ensure accurate and comprehensive data representation of their products. This streamlines inventory management and improves customer engagement by providing detailed product descriptions and specifications.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit detailed information for the Pyrargy Recliner, enabling effective management and customization of this product.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating or updating details of the Pyrargy recliner. Ensure that all required fields are included and formatted correctly to process the request successfully.

200.description: Successfully processed the request and returned the recliner details.

CreateCatalogPyrargyReclinerDetailReques.title: Pyrargy Recliner Order Request

pyrargy_recliner_id.description: The unique identifier for the Pyrargy recliner being ordered.

requestedBy.description: Name of the person who is requesting the order.

quantity.description: The number of Pyrargy recliners being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the order is a priority order.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Pyrargy recliner in the order.

CreateCatalogPyrargyReclinerDetailReques.description: Schema representing a request to order a Pyrargy recliner, including details like quantity, requested by, and pricing.

status.description: The status of the operation indicating success or failure.

CreateCatalogPyrargyReclinerDetailRespon.description: Response schema for the successful operation of recliner details.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the response. This header tells the client the type of content that is being returned, typically used to specify formats such as JSON, XML, or HTML.

x-processing-time.description: Represents the time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This can help clients gauge performance and responsiveness.
